stories.title: Thousands regain water supply after major outage
stories.summary: Some residents were unable to cook, wash or flush their toilets since Tuesday afternoon.

stories.title: Raise The Colours member guilty of dancefloor murder
stories.summary: Billy Allison punched Matthew O'Gara in the neck at a bar in Lichfield in May.

stories.title: 'Lip King unbothered' when mum collapsed after BBL
stories.summary: Alice Webb died in 2024 after having a procedure known as a Brazilian Butt Lift, an inquest hears.

stories.title: 'Bonkers' Shakespeare Institute move must end, says actor
stories.summary: Samuel West is spearheading a petition against the move with more than 16,000 signatures.

stories.title: Council wins legal fight against flags on lamp-posts
stories.summary: In her decision, Judge Emma Kelly says there was a "compelling need" to grant the interim injunction.

stories.title: Albion owners Bilkul pay off 2014 loan
stories.summary: West Bromwich Albion owners Bilkul Football finish paying off the £3.7m loan debt transferred to them six months after they took ownership in 2024.

stories.title: 'Ade starring in I'm A Celeb... is a proud moment for Birmingham'
stories.summary: Ade Adepitan's colleague says Birmingham City University is "so so proud" of him.

stories.title: Jury told prisoner admitted £20,000 killing
stories.summary: A jury hears allegations surrounding the fatal shooting of Harun Khan in March 2008.

stories.title: Man guilty of manslaughter after street attack
stories.summary: Kevin Siviter is cleared of murder but found guilty of manslaughter over Michael Bennett's death.

stories.title: Man pleads guilty to harassing Jess Phillips MP
stories.summary: Lee Owens, 47, will be sentenced next year for sending aggressive and threatening emails to the MP.

stories.title: 'Festive toy appeal will keep Amelia's memory going'
stories.summary: It is in memory of Amelia Kolpa, who died in March after getting 300,000 eighth birthday cards.

stories.title: Third man charged over Raise the Colours flags disorder
stories.summary: Julian Keane, 53, is charged with causing serious injury by dangerous driving.
